meaning.long_meaning: Asari corresponds to the Tamil form None. Its core lexical sense is teacher, preceptor; artisan. Tamil ஆசாரி (ācāri) means a teacher or artisan, from Sanskrit आचार्य. The source gloss 'Free from sorrow' is not the lexical sense.
